title: Five A at rest in a pentagon (side 5.5): does the pair sum hold at N = 5?
pitch: Additivity at N >= 5 is untested; the N = 3, 4 table holds at 0.3 percent. Five A at rest in a regular pentagon, side 5.5, centre (5, 5), T = 1.0, tracker. Every pair stays inside the P-0029 table (5 to 9) over the run (min 5.27, max 8.90), so the prediction is an interpolation. Pre-registered: additive pair sum with the P-0029 K table gives positions; a single scale s fits with s = 1. Falsifier: |s - 1| > 0.05 or judged RMSE/L above 0.021.
